_doc: Pilot 7 matrix (ADR-0037). Read by agentdx/pilot7.py; `python3 -m agentdx pilot7 --dry-run` validates it without any LLM call.

prices._source: Anthropic first-party API list prices, USD per million tokens, as cached in the Claude API reference on that date. cache_write is the 5-minute write (1.25 x input) and cache_read 0.1 x input where the table gives no explicit figure (marked derived). The CLI aliases are assumed to resolve to the current generation; the harness records the resolved model id when Claude Code reports it and checks every trial's computed cost against Claude Code's own total_cost_usd.
